headline: US GDP and Inflation Data
detail: Third-quarter GDP was stronger than expected at 3.4%, but September inflation accelerated. This mixed signal could keep the Fed on hold or even lead to further rate hikes, which typically pressures growth and tech stocks, especially leveraged ones like your holdings.
rec: Monitor how this economic data impacts semiconductor and tech futures. No immediate action warranted on holdings based solely on this.

headline: AI Data Center Insurance Risks
detail: Aon CEO warns AI data center insurance risks could threaten financing. This highlights potential headwinds for the infrastructure supporting AI growth, a sector many of your tech holdings are tied to.
rec: This is a developing risk for the AI infrastructure build-out. Keep an eye on how it might affect sentiment or costs for companies involved in data centers.

headline: Obesity-Drug Boom
detail: Eli Lilly price target raised due to the obesity-drug boom. While not directly in your tech concentration, this shows strong sector-specific growth stories can emerge, potentially diverting capital from other areas.
rec: This headline is positive for the biotech sector but doesn't directly impact your tech/chip focus. No action needed on your current holdings.
